# Llms Txt

> llms.txt is an open standard that gives LLM-powered tools a concise, structured entry point into any website or project, enabling AI assistants and editors to retrieve relevant documentation without scraping raw HTML.

## Guide

- [llms.txt in Different Domains](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/llms-txt/blob/main/nbs/domains.md): This page has some guidelines and suggestions for how different domains could utilize llms.txt to allow LLMs to better interface with their site if they so choose.
- [`ed`, the standard text editor](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/llms-txt/blob/main/nbs/ed.md): In order to understand how llms.txt can be used with editors and IDEs, let's look at how ed, the standard text editor, could work (assuming it's updated to use this proposal).
